prompt_history.prompt: Create a completely new 1536x1024 high-detail anime cinematic MY SGG social-share key visual, conceptually 'Dawn of a Thousand Torii', with no rendered title or text. Exactly SOBI, EBISU, and SAIKA walk toward the viewer in the mid-foreground slightly right of center. Use sobi_main.webp, ebisu_main.webp, and saika_main.webp only as identity anchors; faithfully preserve each face, compact proportions, hair, eyes, costume colors/details, and signature weapon, but redraw all three in a coherent new walking action and shared dawn lighting. Make the immense vermilion torii avenue, deep one-point perspective, sunrise, blue-gray mist, volumetric beams, wet stone paving, moss, and reflections at least half of the visual narrative. Keep the characters in the horizontal center-safe band for a centered 1200x630 crop. No pasted cutout look, collage, panels, extra characters, OTOMO, text, logo, watermark, UI, border, modern objects, sexualization, or photorealism.

Keep the generated torii scene, dawn lighting, rendering, and all three character identities unchanged. Change only the group scale and placement: uniformly reduce the complete three-character group and all equipment by about 18%, move it upward and left, keep the walking poses and order, and fit complete bodies, hair, faces, and signature weapons inside the centered 1200x630 crop of the 1536x1024 canvas. Add nothing and remove nothing.

Move the entire existing three-character group and every part of their equipment straight upward by approximately 40 pixels. Do not scale, rotate, redraw, restyle, reorder, or otherwise change the group or environment. Preserve exact identities, costumes, poses, torii geometry, wet paving, mist, dawn lighting, color grade, anime rendering, and 1536x1024 size. Keep exactly three characters and no text, logo, watermark, border, or UI.
